NONE: A2 used as a way of attracting someone's attention, sometimes in a way that is not very polite

example: Hey! What are you doing with my car?
嘿！你動我的車子幹甚麼？
Hey, are you guys coming to Angela's party?
嘿，你們是要去參加安琪拉的聚會嗎？

NONE: › said when something appears or happens so quickly or easily that it seems to be magic

example: You put your money in the machine and, hey presto, the coffee comes out!
把錢投到機器裡，嘿，咖啡就出來了！

NONE: › the most successful or popular period of someone or something
